## OurESGinPractice

At CyberCube, we are committed to conducting our business in a socially responsible and environmentally sustainable manner.

Our Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) program reflects our dedication to minimizing our environmental impact, fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, and upholding the highest standards of corporate governance.

##### Environmental Stewardship

We aim to embody a commitment to research and take thoughtful concrete actions that positively impact the environment and encourage sustainable solutions.

##### Social Responsibility

We believe people are at the heart of our business and take pride in our outstanding work culture. We strive to be an optimal employer to our workforce as well as a valued partner to our communities.

##### Governance Excellence

We view good governance as essential to creating and preserving value for our stakeholders. This includes a sound approach to corporate governance that complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations and policies, as well as unwavering adherence to our values.

## OurESGteammission

Our commitment to excellence

We are committed to building a team that is supported and inspired to make CyberCube a leading creator of sustainable value for society. Our cross-functional ESG team takes pride in setting long-term strategy and shorter-term goals to achieve this.

We participate in the UN Global Compact, with a commitment to achieving its sustainable development goals and completing the UNGC Communication on Progress statement annually.

Learn more about our environmental, social responsibility, and governance excellence initiatives [here.](https://www.cybcube.com/esg-policy)

#### projects

## Environmental

While delivering the world’s leading cyber risk analytics is our mission, we believe we have a responsibility to minimise the energy, carbon, water, and waste impacts of our business. As a result, we strive to reduce environmental impacts across the full life cycle of our operation, and integrate environmental stewardship in everything we do.

![airplane](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/airplane.jpg)

### Air travel reduction and offset

Our team is encouraged to take low carbon alternatives to air travel, and where air travel is necessary and eligible, we undertake United’s carbon tracking and profiling availabilities.



![hardware](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/hardware.jpg)

### Supply chain auditing

We’re committed to responsible resource management, which includes a comprehensive hardware recycling program.



#### tree planting

### Evertreen x CyberCube

We have partnered with [Evertreen](https://www.evertreen.com/forest/66a282e37a018) to plant 737 trees for our estimated carbon tonnage output from 2023. We endeavour to work towards tracking Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions in future.

These figures were calculated as a combination, but not limited to:

- Industry averages for office/home energy usage
- Corporate travel from source United Airlines and industry estimation
- Our software vendors estimated carbon tonnage

## Social

We aim to actively assess and consider both our internal and external social impact by focusing on employee welfare as well as diversity, equity and inclusion in the broader societal landscape.

swipe

drag

![work-event](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/work-event.jpg)

### Fostering a diverse talent pool

We measure diversity metrics and constantly assess ways to improve them.

We source diverse talent from non-traditional paths and best working practices.

We provide extensive mental health, parental leave, reproductive and gender-affirming healthcare.

![work-meeting](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/work-meeting.jpg)

### Maintaining cultural integrity as we expand

Employees provide feedback with formal mechanisms on cultural issues in 360 feedback sessions with their managers.

Our core values are rewarded to all employees via our employee rewards system, and our company goal setting based around those values.

![colleagues-working](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/colleagues-working.jpg)

### Community involvement & engagement

Volunteering CyberCube expertise to universities & educational events.

Employees are encouraged and supported with two days paid leave for volunteer work, and CyberCube sponsored days in local offices.

![ungc-logo-large](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/ungc-logo-large.jpg)

## Governance

We aim to embed ethical decision-making, policies and stakeholder inclusivity into the DNA of CyberCube, setting an example for responsible business practice.

UN Global Compact Membership

CyberCube is proud to be signatory to the [United Nations Global Compact](https://unglobalcompact.org/) initiative. We are proud to join thousands of companies globally which are committed to taking responsible business action. By integrating a principles-based approach to sustainability, CyberCube is taking shared responsibility for achieving a better world.

## Accountability

We set a high bar for our company. We communicate our goals and hold ourselves accountable for meeting them. We endeavor to be transparent and honest in our external communications of our ESG goals.

We are SOC2 Type 2 and ISO27001 certified.
